decks.title: Repo Day
decks.blurb: Get aboard, restore power, collect three keycards, and trigger the tram override.

decks.title: Hostile Tenancy
decks.blurb: Crew quarters, chapel, and rec decks, where the dead still keep house.

decks.title: Root Cause
decks.blurb: The farms have gone feral and the air is turning against you.

decks.title: Bedside Manner
decks.blurb: Dr. Okafor's labs, and the specs Gorgon sent before anyone reached Ruin.

decks.title: Cold Storage
decks.blurb: Twenty-eight hundred relief miners were sleeping here. Were.

decks.title: Overtime
decks.blurb: Something has clocked in at the reactor and it is not on the payroll.

decks.title: Lockdown
decks.blurb: Sergeant Pruitt locked the ship down. Then he went into the vents.

decks.title: Hostile Takeover
decks.blurb: Gorgon's liaison office, where the real contract is kept.

decks.title: Deep Pockets
decks.blurb: The drill platform and the tunnels it cut into Ruin.

decks.title: Gut Check
decks.blurb: The ship is becoming a body. You are inside it.

decks.title: Breach of Contract
decks.blurb: Down the drill shaft, into whatever was waiting under Ruin.
